FREE · AD-FREE · OPEN SOURCE

An ad-free YouTube Music
alternative for Android.

Aroha Music is a free, ad-free, independent YouTube Music client for Android 8.0 and newer. You can stream music, play it in the background, read lyrics and download supported tracks without creating an account. The original code is open source under GPL-3.0-or-later.

If you want music discovery, background listening, expressive lyrics and a library on your device without creating an account, Aroha is worth exploring.

Looking for an InnerTune alternative?

Aroha is another option for people exploring independent Android music apps. It offers ad-free music playback, YouTube Music discovery, background listening, lyrics and a local library. Aroha is a separate project and is not affiliated with InnerTune.

See real Aroha app screenshots to check the interface before installing.

Ad-free music playback

Aroha does not insert advertising interruptions into playback. No paid subscription is required to use the app. Source availability and content restrictions still apply.

Search and discover music

Search songs, artists, albums and playlists through public YouTube Music discovery. Quick Picks, artist pages and region-aware discovery help you explore. Glimpses adds swipeable previews with likes, playlist saves and a path to the full song.

Keep the music moving

Background audio, shuffle, repeat, queues, crossfade and a sleep timer give you control over your listening. Widgets and Android Auto browsing extend that experience beyond the app’s main screen.

Synced lyrics and lyric styles

Four cinematic lyric styles give words room to breathe. Aroha uses six lyrics providers with learned automatic fallback. Real word timing appears where the source provides it; not every track has synced lyrics.

Your library, on your device

Keep favorites, build playlists, import local audio, back up your library and view on-device Listening Insights. Supported downloads let you save permitted content for offline listening. Availability depends on the source and the rights you have.

What to know before switching

  • Aroha is independent of Google and YouTube. It is not the official YouTube Music app.
  • Playback, artwork, lyrics and downloads depend on third-party sources, network access and content restrictions.
  • Account login, cloud sync, casting and push notifications are not implemented.
  • Aroha is currently for Android. There is no official iOS or browser streaming app.

Get the official APK

Download from the official GitHub release. Android 8.0 or newer is required. The release page includes notes, source archives and checksums.
